summary: A streamlined CLI toolkit for provisioning, managing, and orchestrating virtualized environments across multiple hypervisors and cloud platforms.
key_features: Automated VM provisioning with minimal manual intervention
Reproducible environment deployments via IaC principles
Unified abstraction layer for cross-platform hypervisor/cloud compatibility
Comprehensive CLI for full VM lifecycle management (create, start, stop, status, list)
Optimized repository configuration for AI context exclusion and CI/CD consistency
achievements: Successfully abstracted complex, platform-specific hypervisor and cloud APIs into a single unified workflow. Implemented Infrastructure-as-Code principles to guarantee consistent, reproducible deployments across dev, staging, and production environments. Engineered cross-platform repository configurations to eliminate line-ending conflicts and strategically optimized AI/LLM context windows to reduce token usage and improve code analysis accuracy.
